extracted.intended_audience: Senior CIA officials (Executive Director - Comptroller, OGC, OPPB) and agency leadership preparing a reply to OMB
extracted.subtask_short: reply to OMB on Circular A-63
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and dispatch an agency reply to OMB's 22 June memorandum proposing revisions to OMB Circular A-63 (implementing Executive Order 11671), including legal analysis of whether the disclosure provisions and committee-definitions apply to CIA and its participation in USIB and subcommittees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability of EO 11671 disclosure provisions to CIA
rubrics_metrics.description: The disclosure provisions of E. O. 11671 are inapplicable to CIA; it would be useful to go on record with OMB in this regard in timely fashion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position derives from Agency views and the Legislative Counsel memorandum of 8 June (approved by the Director). Although believed to be the correct legal interpretation, OMB may have intended otherwise, so the Agency should state its view formally and be prepared to furnish information voluntarily if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whether CIA participation in USIB and subcommittees is subject to the Executive Order and revised Circular
rubrics_metrics.description: CIA participation in USIB and the various USIB subcommittees is not subject to the Executive Order and the revised Circular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale: definitions of 'advisory committee,' 'industry committee' and 'interagency committee' in the Executive Order would not include USIB and its subcommittees. However, because prior reporting under Circular A-63 occurred (1966-1971) and definitions are not significantly different, OMB might expect continuity; be prepared to explain the legal distinctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: 'advisory committee' exclusion for USIB subcommittees
rubrics_metrics.description: USIB subcommittees would not be 'advisory committees' because they are composed wholly of government officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite subsections 1(6), (7) and (8) of the Executive Order. If OMB disputes this interpretation, note the Agency's historical practice of reporting and be prepared to provide committee information as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: 'industry committee' exclusion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple factual basis: composition is government officials, not industry participants; use this to distinguish from categories that trigger disclosure obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: 'interagency committee' exclusion for USIB subcommittees
rubrics_metrics.description: USIB subcommittees are not 'interagency committees' because they are established by the Director of Central Intelligence as Chairman of USIB under authority of a National Security Council Intelligence Directive and not 'by a department or agency.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize the origin and authority for establishment (DCI under NSCID) when explaining why the interagency definition does not apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historical reporting / continuity consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency has reported to OMB under the existing Circular A-63 and the then-current Executive Order for the years 1966 through 1971 and the definitions of the two Orders are not significantly different in these regards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of prior reporting, OMB may assume reporting should continue; the reply should acknowledge past practice while explaining the legal reasons for non-applicability to CIA/USIB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation to sign and dispatch proposed reply
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommend that the draft reply to the Assistant Director of OMB be signed and dispatched and that OPPB advise the International Division of our reply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Action guidance: dispatch the reply promptly, inform International Division of the Agency's position, and assure them the Agency will furnish any information on committee activities which the Division may request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary cooperation with OMB International Division
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency is willing to furnish the International Division any information it desires concerning CIA participation in USIB and other committees, with or without the existence of an Executive Order requiring us to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain good relations with OMB by offering to provide requested information while simultaneously asserting the Director's position and powers as head of Central Intelligence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness of response to OMB comment request
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB requested comments by 7 July on the proposed revision of Circular A-63 (OMB memorandum dated 22 June).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because timeliness matters, the Agency should prepare and send its reply promptly to ensure its position is on record within the requested timeframe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal basis citation and approval
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's position should be grounded in the Legislative Counsel memorandum (8 June) and other legal analyses, and approved by the Director.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include referenced legal memoranda and indicate Director's approval (as in the memo) when presenting the legal interpretation to OMB to strengthen the reply's authority.
